scope: Fictional injected current-owner call/slot facts. Labels denote opaque objects constructed by a later closed test harness, never serialized production authority or a measured C execution history.
ordinary_types: All integer fields require exact int, never bool; flags exact bool; arrays exact list at fixture boundary; reference/enum strings exact finite grammar. No executable snippets, open paths, caller checker functions or arbitrary field sets.

tags.UNOBSERVED: value must be null; harness decodes to one dedicated private sentinel object, not None or0
tags.NULL: value null; explicitly OBSERVED null pointer, distinct from sentinel and not guessed failure ownership
tags.HANDLE: strict uint64 including0 and18446744073709551615; function-specific interpretation
tags.BOOL32: strict signed32 raw BOOL; nonzero is success, no bool normalization of the stored fact
tags.COUNT32: strict uint32 observed count cell; observation alone does not mean count-defined

first_fact_atom.sole_authority: A stored atom other than UNOBSERVED is the first observed value fact. scalar_aux_ack/count_aux_ack/right_transfer_ack may remain false; neither a later flag nor a multi-field transaction is required to preserve the value. Reconciliation derives facts from the field/sentinel, not auxiliary flags.
first_fact_atom.count_defined: For ReadFile/WriteFile ONLY: stored raw BOOL32 nonzero, count atom COUNT32, and0<=count<=the predeclared request. UNOBSERVED count, failed BOOL, or out-of-range count is unknown. A COUNT32 value0 sampled from initialized storage with false BOOL is observed but not defined; successful/defined0 is a distinct known zero.
first_fact_atom.residual_window: No fixture claims observation between C return and Python conversion/first storage. An invocation whose scalar field remains UNOBSERVED has an unknown return/effect, even if C might have returned. Preallocation does not establish atomicity.

initial_objects: List of exact{id,kind,scope}; id ASCII[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,31}, unique. kind owner/origin/nonce/registry/port/output/source_context/loader/journal/file_identity/buffer/exception. scope HARNESS_ONLY. Different labels MUST produce distinct opaque object identity even when numeric starts or bytes agree.
clock_rules: Source-issued original object, start0/work295000000000/hard300000000000 in these fixtures. Steps advance monotonically, never reset. The numeric values are synthetic data, not sufficient owner identity or a live first-clock guarantee.
slot_rule: Any initial usable file/search handle and identity capability is an explicit HARNESS_ONLY precondition tied to its actual typed owner/nonce/slot. Production must not accept this descriptor, HarnessIdentityPrecondition, a dict or an identity_ok flag as proof. Empty open-target slots start UNOBSERVED/no close right.
buffer_rule: Closed fake buffer object, generation0..3, canonical lowercase even hex<=capacity. A reserved call retains the exact object+generation before invocation. Raw fake writes may populate it before scalar storage; no reuse while returned bytes remain uncopied/unhashed or an operation failed. No reported path/file is read.
exception_rule: Harness constructs ONE exception object per ref before the trace; future pure tests compare original object identity, not just class/message. An already latched primary is never replaced by wrapper/close/publication errors.
early_context_rule: Explicit fictional preexisting live-source capture from the SAME owner/Origin/nonce/registry/port/loader/journal; scope HARNESS_ONLY. Reusing the exact objects/immutable bytes and spent time is tested. This is not a source-freshness claim or a ready token accepted from JSON. Later closed harness must construct typed context through the reviewed injected factory interfaces; production/live/source gates remain pending.
call_record_rule: Preallocate every field before invoke. raw_scalar/raw_count initially UNOBSERVED. No RawReturn/error copy/log/clock/copy/hash is needed to hold a first fact. Fields retain function-specific values when a wrapper later raises. Ordinal belongs to exactly one current owner/API/slot descriptor.

step_rules.reserve: Only one exact descriptor per ordinal. Identical reconcile is idempotent; a conflicting reserve/fact/foreign reference rejects before a new invocation and does not alter the original record.
step_rules.invoke: Conservative FFI-invocation reservation under the original clock and current typed identity. It is not proof of actual native entry. Close invocation consumes the single right BEFORE the call; wrong closer or repeated close does not dispatch.
step_rules.scalar_count: A direct first-fact assignment in the under-test record, before aux updates. Conflicting repeated value writes reject; identical value observation/reconcile must not double-count.
step_rules.aux: field is scalar_aux_ack/count_aux_ack/right_transfer_ack only. It is diagnostic bookkeeping, not eligibility or the source of an observed fact.
step_rules.raise: ordinal is existing ordinal or null for pure handoff/control stop. phase is from the closed phase enum. Stop future work, preserve raw facts/first primary, permit only declared same-owner reconciliation/once cleanup while hard time allows.
step_rules.copy_hash: Pure buffer-copy/hash component actions, not fixture-driven successful counts. A missing/throwing action cannot set a positive captured/hash byte count; exact known raw slice remains retained. Tests later execute real pure helpers with injected failures, not authored expected outcomes.
step_rules.handoff: Exact same current object references; at most one claim. No new owner/Origin/output reservation, no early-source reopen, no run_once invocation. Foreign references fail even if scalar starts/bytes match.
step_rules.clock: No fresh work at/after work_end, no further invocation at/after hard_end. Previously stored facts/buffers survive; cleanup deadline cannot erase known ownership or report a positive pin.

counter_rules: Known scalar/count values fold once from non-UNOBSERVED first facts by current ordinal, independent of aux flags and number/order of reconciliations. Wrapper returns count separately. These are fictional reserved/observed axes, not a measured C-entry/callee-execution census. No resetting earlier known counts during continuation.
checkpoint_rule: Each exact{after_step,projection} is an authored read-only before/after-fault expectation. Projection keys use this schema's exact expected-record/slot/counter field paths. A future harness compares them; they never steer implementation behavior.
